title: Tauroarenarones A and B, New Taurine-containing Meroterpenoids from the Marine Sponge Dysidea sp

sections.abstract: <jats:p>Two new taurine-containing meroterpenoids, both arenarone derivatives, tauroarenarone A (1) and tauroarenarone B (2), have been isolated from the Australian marine sponge Dysidea sp. Their structures were established from NMR spectroscopic data.</jats:p>
